# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest major version receives fixes. Older majors carry older ICD-10-CM releases and don't get backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lowlysre/icd-10-cm/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue.

Incorrect or missing code data isn't a security issue: open a regular [issue](https://github.com/lowlysre/icd-10-cm/issues/new/choose) for those.
